units: NDVI per decade (1/(10 a)), Theil-Sen slope and Sen's 95% interval
sci52_rule: Per SCI-52 (Wilks 2016), pixel-wise significance maps (thresholded p-value or FDR class maps) are never published or drawn. Display rasters and reveal frames paint only the continuous Theil-Sen slope direction and magnitude on a fixed scale; Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (q = 0.05) area shares and per-pixel interval shares are reported in the summary tables with the 2.5% per-direction chance benchmark.
cell_corners: MODIS sinusoidal pixel corners (231.66 m) to lon/lat (pyproj) to EPSG:32629
